incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> CANARY_HEALTHCHECK_FAILURE triggered for service=canary-router50 region=us-west-2 (count=3 in 60s). Alert panels: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/canary?panelId=7
PagerDuty: Incident INC-112233 created and routed to on-call (Ian). PagerDuty: page fired.
Ian: taking this, looking at grafana and traces now.
Ian: quick check — this looks isolated to the synthetic canary checks, not real user traffic. No 5xx spike on prod frontdoor.
```
prod-frontend 5xx: 0/1m
canary-router50 5xx: 3/1m (synthetic checks)
```
Lee: pulling pods/logs in canary namespace, grabbing short output.
```
$ kubectl get pods -n canary -l app=router50
router50-5b7d9   Running   0/1   3m
router50-6c8f2   CrashLoopBackOff   1/4   2m
```
Lee: logs from router50-6c8f2 show liveness probe failures then a success: 
```
[2026-03-15T12:34:10Z] liveness probe failed: read timeout after 200ms
[2026-03-15T12:34:20Z] probe succeeded
```
Maria: any customer impact? :eyes:
Ian: no user-facing errors in traces, only canary synthetic hits. frontdoor traces show requests succeeding. PagerDuty note: alert auto-resolved shortly after firing (no continued noisy firing).
incident-bot: Alert INC-112233 auto-resolved by rule at 3389005595 (flap window).
Lee: my read — one pod had transient flakiness (probe timeout), likely node-level network hiccup or a GC stall. Not seeing repeated failures across the fleet.
Ian: agreed. no customer impact, but canary flapping is noisy. Suggest we avoid immediate platform change; monitor for recurrence for 30m and open an infra ticket if it repeats. Also suggest temp suppression of canary alert to 5m to avoid inbox churn while we triage.
Maria: please file a follow-up so we don't lose this: assign to infra team, include pod logs + grafana link.
Ian: filing ISSUE-2761 now with logs, pod names, and grafana link: https://issues.redwood/ISSUE-2761
Lee: will watch metrics + raise a PR to adjust probe timeout in canary only if we see another hit. For now leaving production probes unchanged.
Maria: ack — thanks for the quick triage. No customer impact, monitor & follow-up ticket exists.
Ian: closing thread, keeping an eye for 30m. :white_check_mark:
